items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Then you later changed. To what? You put your upper teeth on there, Ralph? No, not at all.

ctx.x: Then you later changed. To what? You put your upper teeth on there, Ralph? No, not at all.
You put both lips on. That's right. The method book tells you. Yeah. The teeth should guide on the mouthpiece.
